name: Kami Jigen Idol Neptune PP
original_name: 神次元アイドル ネプテューヌPP
source: The player takes on the role of the main character, who falls into Gamindustri and is immediately hired by one of the four CPUs—Neptune, Noire, Blanc, and Vert—to be their producer and manage their idol careers.
